info.title: Capsule Web API
info.description: Developer documentation for Capsule ecosystem web services. All endpoints communicate via JSON payload over POST requests unless specified otherwise. Rate limiting and application-level authentication apply.

tags.name: Games
tags.description: Endpoints managing game entities and active server lists.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Endpoints for resolving, paginating, and modifying user accounts.

get.description: Validates the active session via PHPSESSID cookie and returns the authenticated user's profile metadata.

200.description: Active session detected. User profile details returned successfully.

401.description: Unauthorized. Missing, invalid, or expired session context.

post.description: Clears user authentication state, invalidating active session cookies, tokens, or persistent login hashes.

200.description: Session successfully terminated. Client-side authentication structures should be cleared.

401.description: Unauthorized. No active session context was detected.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Enforces POST protocol for secure session mutation.

get.description: Fetches a paginated list of publicly visible (public=1) games. Results are sorted by creation date in descending order (`created_at DESC`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number for pagination control. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

200.description: Successfully retrieved list of active games with pagination metadata.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Only GET requests are accepted for this endpoint.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Typically caused by database connection issues or encoding anomalies.

get.description: Returns comprehensive entity data for a single game identified by its unique integer ID. Includes structured thumbnail metadata.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique database identifier (Primary Key) of the game entity.

200.description: Game details successfully resolved and returned.

400.description: Bad Request. Missing or invalid integer provided for the 'id' parameter.

404.description: Not Found. No game entity exists with the specified ID.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Only GET requests are accepted.

post.description: Provisions a new game record within the system. Payload validation enforces ownership constraints and structural media verification. `thumbnail_urls` array accepts a hard cap of 8 media objects.

desc.example: An immersive tactical survival experience built on edge-case mechanics.

ownerUserId.description: The unique identifier of the user provisioning this game instance.

public.description: Visibility state control toggle. 0 = Private/Hidden, 1 = Publicly Discovered.

thumbnail_urls.description: Collection of media assets bound to the game entity. Maximum size: 8 elements.

value.description: Asset platform asset ID or reference string.

201.description: Entity created successfully. Returns the auto-incremented database ID.

400.description: Validation Failed. Missing required properties, layout misconfiguration, or media array boundary exceeded.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Enforces POST protocol.

post.description: Performs a partial or complete layout mutation on an existing game record using a coalesce patching approach. Properties omitted from the request body payload explicitly retain their previous state in the database. The record's ID remains read-only and immutable.

id.description: The targeted game instance identifier. Cannot be mutated.

name.example: LAST MAN ON EARTH; BOB (Beta v2)

desc.example: Updated patch logs, system mechanics, and world state updates.

thumbnail_urls.description: Overwrites the current array entirely. Subject to standard array boundary constraint filters (Max: 8 items).

200.description: Mutation successfully committed. `updated_at` system timestamp updated automatically.

400.description: Bad Request. Target ID property omitted, array overflow, or structural payload data corruption.

404.description: Not Found. Transaction aborted because the target ID does not exist.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Endpoint requires POST payload mapping.

get.description: Searches for publicly visible games matching the search term in their name or description fields.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page number for pagination control. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

200.description: Returns matching game results with pagination metadata.

400.description: Bad Request. The query parameter 'q' is missing or blank.

405.description: Method Not Allowed. Only GET requests are supported.

get.description: Returns a single user's public profile data. Client must provide either 'id' or 'username' as a query parameter.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique database identifier of the user.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The unique alphanumeric username string of the user.

200.description: User details successfully resolved and returned.

400.description: Bad Request. Both 'id' and 'username' parameters were omitted or conflicting.

404.description: Not Found. No user entity matches the provided criteria.

get.description: Fetches a globally paginated array of users sorted by registration date in descending order.

200.description: Successfully retrieved users array with total records and pagination metadata.

500.description: Internal Server Error. Database query failure.

get.summary: Fetch a user's avatar color identity
get.description: Directly extracts the hex color signature string representing the target user's custom layout avatar. Use either 'id' OR 'username'.

200.description: Avatar hex string correctly resolved. Defaults to '#ffffff' if unconfigured.

400.description: Bad Request. Required identification parameters missing or mismatched.

post.description: Performs a partial or complete mutation on the authenticated user's profile. Properties omitted from the request payload explicitly retain their previous state.

user_id.description: The current authenticating user identifier (to be replaced by Session token later).

username.description: New custom unique alphanumeric username to assign.

avatar.description: New target CSS/Hex color system configuration tag.

400.description: Bad Request. Missing required fields or payload data corruption.

401.description: Unauthorized. Provided authorization context missing or empty.

409.description: Conflict. Selected target username is already assigned to another active identity.

get.description: Finds registered users with usernames matching the provided search keyword.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Alphanumeric search term to query against usernames.

200.description: Returns array of matched user entities and details.

400.description: Bad Request. Missing search query parameter 'q'.
